Source Monster

Monster: Desert Seltas | CR: 4 | Tier: 1

Compatible Slots: Armor, Weapon

Weapon Effect

(Gunlance Only) Artillery. While attuned to this weapon, your wyvernfire can now be used twice per long rest.

Armor Effect

Minor Guard Up. When you fail a Dexterity or Strength saving throw, you can use your reaction to use your AC in place of your roll. Once you use this property you can't use it again until you finish a long rest.

Tags: weapon-type:gunlance, mechanic:class-feature, mechanic:long-rest, type:offensive, mechanic:reaction, mechanic:saving-throw, mechanic:ac, type:defensive
